# Half-press hook

A shutter half-press path used to run code once the card is ready.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x60415216` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Resumes at 0x6041521b. Caduceus loads its films at the first half-press after switching on.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): Listed under Proven on the camera in the OM-3 developer notes. Source: [Caduceus OM-3 developer notes](../sources/om3.devnotes.md).
- **Emulator** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): The call site ran at each shutter event in a lab session. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
